caption: The drawing features a brass-colored candlestick with a square base, gradually tapering upwards with a series of rounded and angular decorative bands along its height. To the left of the main colored illustration, there is a precise line drawing of the candlestick's profile in black and white, showing its symmetrical structure. Directly below this line drawing is a geometric overhead view of the base, illustrating its square and circular arrangement, also rendered in black and white. A small scale with the label "INCHES" is drawn beneath the base diagram, providing a sense of size. The candlestick is shaded in yellow-brown and olive tones, giving it a metallic appearance, and the entire composition is enclosed within a rectangular border. The name “J. Schaumpf” is written in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Candlestick
